# API Guide

**Base URL:** `/api/v1`
**Authoritative reference:** [`api/openapi.json`](api/openapi.json) — generated by the backend. Frontend types are produced from it via `npm run generate:types` (`openapi-typescript` → `src/types/api.d.ts`). This page is a compact map only.

---

## Authentication

All protected endpoints use **HttpOnly session cookies** — there is no Bearer token.

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/register` | Create account (public) |
| POST | `/auth/login` | Set session cookie (public) |
| GET | `/auth/csrf-token` | Fetch CSRF cookie (public); echo as `X-CSRF-Token` on `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` |
| POST | `/auth/refresh` | Rotate session cookie (public; called by the shared 401 interceptor) |
| GET | `/auth/me` | Current user |
| POST | `/auth/change-password` | Change own password |
| POST | `/auth/revoke` | Logout / revoke current token |
| POST | `/auth/revoke-all` | Revoke all tokens (admin may target another `user_id`) |

Every request sends the session cookie with `credentials: 'include'`. Note: logout is `POST /auth/revoke`, not `/auth/logout`.

## Colonies

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/colonies` | List colonies the user can access (paginated) |
| POST | `/colonies` | Create colony (`name`, `founder_name`, `colony_type`, optional `base_size`) |
| GET | `/colonies/{colony_id}` | Full colony incl. computed `state` |
| PUT | `/colonies/{colony_id}` | Update name / founder / patron / `age_days` / `current_event` |
| GET | `/colonies/{colony_id}/state` | Computed state (per-stat base/current/lore-state, PF) |
| GET | `/colonies/{colony_id}/roll-status` | Event/development roll cadence |
| GET | `/colonies/{colony_id}/modifier-breakdown` | Per-stat contribution breakdown |
| POST | `/colonies/{colony_id}/age` | Advance age: `{"add": 90}`, `{"set": 365}` or `{"subtract": 45}` (result ≥ 0) |
| GET / POST | `/colonies/{colony_id}/modifiers` | List / add a custom modifier |
| PATCH / DELETE | `/colonies/{colony_id}/modifiers/{modifier_id}` | Toggle, edit, or remove a modifier |
| POST / DELETE | `/colonies/{colony_id}/representative` | Assign / unassign the representative (1:1) |
| GET | `/colonies/{colony_id}/export` | Export colony to JSON |
| POST | `/colonies/import` | Import colony JSON |

## Members, Audit, Users (permissions noted)

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET / POST | `/colonies/{colony_id}/members` | Colony membership |
| PATCH / DELETE | `/colonies/{colony_id}/members/{user_id}` | Update role / remove member |
| POST | `/colonies/{colony_id}/members/transfer-ownership` | Transfer ownership |
| GET | `/colonies/{colony_id}/audit-logs` · `/audit-logs/{log_id}` | Change history |
| GET / POST | `/users` | List/create users (admin) |
| GET / PATCH / DELETE | `/users/{user_id}` | Get/update/delete user (admin) |
| POST | `/users/{user_id}/reset-password` | Reset password (admin) |

---

## Responses & errors

- `200` OK · `201` Created · `204` No Content (delete)
- Error body: `{ "detail": "...", "path": "..." }`
- Codes: `400` domain/invalid input · `401` unauthenticated · `403` insufficient permission · `404` not found · `409` conflict · `422` validation · `429` rate limited · `500` server error
- Paginated lists: `?offset=&limit=` → `{ "items": [...], "meta": { "total", "offset", "limit", "has_more" } }`

Access all details in Swagger UI (`GET /docs`, cookie-aware) or ReDoc (`/redoc`).
